title: One Print Style Across Plants
tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

faults.what: The Monstera slide is missing: only three separate slides are supplied, starting with Snake plant.
The repeated template varies slightly: the Pothos pot is wider with a higher rim, and the lettering is larger than on the Snake plant slide.

judge.summary: Three attractive, closely matched plant slides were delivered, but the required opening Monstera slide is missing.

must_haves.item: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
must_haves.why: Only three square slides are visible: Snake plant, Pothos, and Peace lily; Monstera is absent.

must_haves.item: The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
must_haves.why: The three supplied plants are recognizable, including upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and pale peace-lily spathes, but no Monstera is supplied.

must_haves.item: All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
must_haves.why: The three supplied illustrations consistently use the requested palette and print treatment, but the fourth illustration is missing.

must_haves.item: Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
must_haves.why: The visible borders, serif lettering, and paper texture closely match, but pot proportions vary slightly and there is no fourth slide.

must_haves.item: Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.
must_haves.why: All supplied names are readable and the layouts closely align, but pot proportions and lettering size also change slightly, and the Monstera slide is missing.
